title: ROW returns a vertical array up to 1,048,576 rows on multi-row areas and #REF! on multi-area unions
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, ROW([reference]) returns a single number for a 1-row reference (or when omitted, the caller's row) and a vertical array of 1-based row numbers for multi-row areas up to 1,048,576 rows (spilling, or returning #SPILL! if placement overflows the sheet edge, while @ROW returns the top row). Multi-area references return #REF!, and non-reference values such as ROW(CHOOSE(1,5)) return #VALUE!.
basis: Measured across cfunc_m3_6 (lookup_edges rows 138-183 and reference_result row 25) in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, and matched across 3,058/3,058 full-bank ROW rows.
